FULL TEXT:
Off: {2782511, 2534645}
EPABX: 4645, 4647
DEPARTMENT OF EVENING STUDIES-MULTI DISCIPLINARY RESEARCH CENTRE
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH-160014
No.182/DES
Date: 25.01.2023
Notice
Applications are invited for the appointment of Guest Faculty in the following subjects
for the academic session 2022-2023 (even semesters) in the Department of Evening
Studies –MDRC, Panjab University, Chandigarh: -
Subject No. of Vacancies
Commerce 01
Political Science 01
History 01
English 02
Days of teaching Classes to be taught Working hours
Monday to Friday B.A./BCOM/M.A. 2.00 PM to 9.00 PM
Last date of submission of Application form: 06.02.2023 upto (05.00 PM)
Qualifications: -
i) Good academic record as defined by the concerned University with at least 55%
marks (50% for SC/ST/Physically & Visually Handicapped) or an equivalent
grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed at the Master’s degree
level in a relevant subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree
from an accredited foreign University.
ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate should have either
cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, or similar test
accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET.
iii) Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-clauses (i) and (ii) to this Clause
4.4.1, candidates, who are, or have been awarded a Ph.D Degree in accordance
with the University Grant Commission (Minimum standard and Procedure for
Award of Ph.D Degree) Regulations, 2009, or the subsequent Regulation if
notified by the UGC, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET/SLET/SET for recruitment and appointment of
Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
* For the post of Guest Faculty in Commerce, a candidate should have
Masters Degree in Commerce with UGC-NET in Commerce. Vide (Circular
No. Misc./A5/83130-83330 dated 27/12/2016.
Further, the award of degrees to candidates registered for the
M.Phil/Ph.Dprogramme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the
provisions of the then existing Ordinances/ By laws/ Regulations of the
Institution awarding the degrees and the Ph.D candidates shall be exempted from
the requirement of the minimum eligibility condition of “NET/SLET/SET for
recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in
Universities / Colleges / Institutions subject to the fulfilment of the following
conditions: -
(a) Ph.D. degree of the candidate awarded in regular mode only;
(b) Evaluation of the Ph.D. thesis by at least two external examiners;
(c) Candidate had published two research papers out of which at least one in a
refereed journal from out of his/her Ph.D. work;
(d) The candidate had presented two papers in seminars/conferences from out of
his/her Ph.D. work;
(e) Open Ph.D. viva-voce of the candidate had been conducted.
(a) to (e) as above are to be certified by the Vice-Chancellor/ Pro-Vice-Chancellor/
Dean (Academic Affairs)/Dean (University Instructions)”
iv. NET/SLET/SET shall also not be required for such Masters Programmes in
disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted.
The applicants are required to fill the application form
(hard copy only) available at Panjab University website under
employment/jobs (Direct recruitment Assistant Professor application form (As per UGC
Regulation 2018) or directly download via using following web link:-
https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2
018.pdf
Applicants are required to submit the application form duly filled in all
respect along with the attested copies of the relevant academic
testimonials/certificates along with (five (05) copies of duly filled
application forms page 1 to 9 only) to the Office, Department of
Evening Studies, Panjab University, Chandigarh, latest by
0 6 . 0 2 . 2 0 2 3 upto 05.00 PM. The applicants are advised to bring their
original certificates and other relevant documents for verification along-with the
duly filled form giving the details at the time of interview. The applicant shall have
to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend during
the above said assignment. If a candidate is getting any financial assistance from
any institution then he/she will have to submit NOC from the concerned
institution at the time of interview.
The above mentioned appointment as guest faculty is on lecture basis with a token
honorarium of Rs. 1000/- per lecture with the ceiling of Rs. 25000/- per month.
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
The date of interview would be mentioned on the online notice
board of the DES department and also intimated to the
candidates by email id provided in the application form.
Sd/-
(Prof. Neeraj Jain)
Chairperson
P.S. Kindly submit Five (05) copies of the application form {Page 1 to 9) in the office
of DES-MDRC along with master copy.
